note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-17, when bug-report converted from command to procedural species so it and its two siblings — issue, feature — can invoke each other directly on a mis-routed ask instead of just pointing the user at a command). Positives: natural bug/repro/regression phrasings plus id-resume syntax, plus (t07-t08) the maximum-collision class a fresh-context review flagged — a bug report phrased in ISSUE vocabulary ('file a github issue for...', 'open an issue about...') that must still trigger bug-report despite the word 'issue' pulling toward the sibling and forge's github-issue-pr-primitives pack. Negatives drawn adversarially from the two siblings (feature-shaped and chore-shaped asks must NOT trigger bug-report), from github-issue-pr-primitives itself (a platform-facts pack that could plausibly fire on issue-shaped language but answers a different question), doc-review, and intent-extract used standalone rather than as bug-report's internal Phase 2.
